slug: 2024-10-23 Electronic Transactions A Consumer Right - Consumer Protection Commission

ZWE.note: Only a fee exemption by the Reserve Bank; no mandate, licensing or switch stated.

facts.fact: The Consumer Protection Act Chapter 14.44 Section 51(h) gives consumers the right to choose their mode of payment, and the Finance Act 2018 amendment to Chapter 24:24 requires businesses to offer electronic payment, per the Consumer Protection Commission.
A Consumer Protection Commission blitz found 80 percent of 27 service stations inspected had no POS machines and issued them Compliance Notices under Section 68.

ZWE.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
No mobile money or e-money service named in service.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
